import pkg1 from "@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node" ; import pkg2 from "@opentelemetry/instrumentation" ; const { NodeTracerProvider , BatchSpanProcessor , TraceIdRatioBasedSampler } = pkg1 ; const { registerInstrumentations } = pkg2 ; const provider = new NodeTracerProvider ( // Provide your chosen NodeTracerConfig such as sampler and span limits { sampler : new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler ( 0.1 ), } ); provider . addSpanProcessor ( new BatchSpanProcessor ( new TraceExporter ()));
